home.headline: Edit PDFs without giving them away
home.sub: Merge, sign, redact, OCR and more — 100% in your browser. No upload, no signup, no limits.
home.privacy: Everything runs on your device. Your files are never uploaded.
home.errorType: That doesn't look like a PDF. Try another file.
home.errorImage: Those don't look like images. Try JPG or PNG files.

features.redactSub: Truly remove sensitive text — not just cover it.

exp.imgSub: Save every page as a JPG or PNG, bundled in a zip.
exp.splitSub: Save each page as its own PDF, bundled in a zip.
exp.note: Downloads a .zip with one PDF per page.

info.title: Document properties
info.sub: Set the title, author and keywords stored inside the PDF.
info.author: Author
info.subject: Subject
info.note: Saved into the file's metadata when you download.

protect.title: Password-protect this PDF
protect.sub: Require a password to open the document. Encryption happens on your device.
protect.passwordPlaceholder: Leave blank to only restrict actions
protect.note: There is no way to recover the open password — store it safely. Restrictions are enforced by PDF readers.

compress.title: Reduce file size
compress.sub: Shrink large or scanned PDFs so they're easy to email and upload.
compress.note: Pages are re-rendered as images, so text becomes non-selectable. Run OCR first if you need searchable text.

stamp.wmSub: Stamp text diagonally across every page.
stamp.numSub: Add page numbers in the position and format you choose.

ocr.title: Make this PDF searchable
ocr.sub: Scanned or image-only PDF? Add an invisible text layer so you can search, select and copy the text.
ocr.done: Searchable text added to {{n}} pages. Download to keep it.
ocr.note: Your document stays on your device. The OCR engine downloads once on first use, then is cached so OCR keeps working offline.

forms.hint: Fill the fields below, then Download. Values are baked in and the form is flattened.
forms.none: No fillable form fields found in this PDF.

crop.note: Draw a box on a page to crop it to that area. ({{count}} cropped)

redact.note: Redacted pages are flattened on export — hidden content is permanently removed. ({{count}} marked)

sign.title: Add your signature
sign.uploadHint: Pick an image of your signature (PNG with transparent background works best).
